abstract: Using the upgraded AOS to log the actions from the previous tick.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 84

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="read_data",
    target="agency_schemas.json",
    metadata={"path": "shared/agency_lab/agency_schemas.json"}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="log_actions",
    target="tick_83",
    metadata={"eval_id": 198}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
